item.title: Lesson 124: “Let me remember I am one with God.”
item.description: “Let me remember I am one with God.” Today we will again give thanks for our identity in God. Our home is safe, protection guaranteed in all we do, power and strength available to us in all our undertakings. We can fail in nothing.
